title: Crepier — Peru/Ecuador multistore with country selector and bundles
summary: Magento e-commerce implementation with separate stores for Peru and Ecuador, a shared country selector, bundles, and editable landing-page components.
context: Retail chain with presence in Peru and Ecuador that needed two stores with independent catalogs and pricing but a coherent brand experience. The challenge was to share navigation and components across countries without duplicating maintenance work and respecting each market's commercial and regulatory specifics.
challenges: Separate commercial scope (catalog, prices, currency, taxes) per country without fragmenting the codebase.
Build a visible and persistent country selector that switches store without losing context.
Model bundles that combine variable products per market.
Let the marketing team edit landing pages and sections without touching code.
approach: Magento 2 multistore: store view per country, a shared base theme, and per-store overrides.
Country-selector component that detects the user's country and allows manual switching between Peru and Ecuador.
Bundle catalog with rules that combine simple and configurable products based on per-market stock.
CMS blocks and manageable widgets so marketing can run landing pages and home sections without redeploys.
outcomes: Two live stores (Peru and Ecuador) sharing base navigation and components.
Country selector working between both stores without breaking the cart.
Landing pages and sections editable by the in-house team without touching the repository.
Final conversion and abandonment metrics pending validation before publishing.
pendingAssets: Screenshots of the country selector and editable landing pages
